My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Thank you for reporting that your item arrived damaged.
Please follow these steps:



Keep the item and packaging for now.


Take clear photos of:


the damaged item


the outer packaging


the inner packaging


any shipping label, if visible


Do not send the item back until you receive further instructions.



Based on the available information, once a damage or warranty claim is reviewed, next-step instructions will be provided. In some cases, a replacement part may be sent if it is easy to install; in other cases, the item may need to be inspected before repair or replacement.
